approval.notes: Justin accepted 2026-09-19: 530 municipality-wide offices (265 Mayor + 265 Municipal council) as municipal (human_review_required=false). HOLD 3067 submunicipal (35 District mayor + 3032 Village mayor) for category policy; human_review_required remains true with review_category=submunicipal_scope. Do not invent a regional layer. Future importer loads only the 530 approved rows unless policy changes. Градец / qualification-change research holds remain open. Geographic tier acceptance only; importer/SQLite/VPS/UI wait.

schema_compatibility_note: Legacy council metadata follows prior Europe file shape, but council is not an allowed geographic tier in unchanged master DDL. No row emits it. An unresolved future hold uses null tier + unknown review; never unknown→other.

importer_policy.note: Future Atlas importer must load only the 530 municipality-wide approved rows unless Justin changes submunicipal policy. Do not silently promote the 3067 held rows.

rules.statement: 265 existing Mayor +265 Municipal council rows → municipal. Justin accepted 2026-09-19; human_review_required=false. No additional offices.

3032 Village mayor +35 District mayor rows remain proposed municipal with human_review_required=true, tier_uncertain=true, review_category=submunicipal_scope. Justin HOLD 2026-09-19: not production-approved. Do not invent a regional layer.
No register institution establishes regional tier; province codes/cohort text never classify. Regional numerator=0 is valid.

Justin accepted 530 municipality-wide rows (Mayor + Municipal council). 3067 district/village remain held. Tier acceptance does not certify 2027 eligibility, resolve histories, or close research gaps including Градец qualification-change.

notes.note: The register names 3,597 offices from all 265 municipalities and the 2023 district/village roster. Archived official CIK pages recover 1,776 usable 2015 village/district histories, including 1,555 exact candidate-vote vectors and 221 percentage-only vectors. First rounds and runoffs are one cycle. Some archived pages, older histories and decisive outcomes remain missing; unresolved first rounds are excluded from completed histories. Original certificates, final 2027 village eligibility and announcements after the 28 August replacement-register snapshot remain unverified.

Justin HOLD 2026-09-19: 3067 existing district/village offices remain proposed municipal with explicit scope review (human_review_required=true, review_category=submunicipal_scope). Not production-approved. Future importer loads only the 530 municipality-wide accepted rows unless policy changes. 2023 roster is not verified 2027 eligibility; no regional layer inferred.
Fewer than three supplied selected histories. Do not synthesize older archives or use unresolved first rounds as a third completed cycle.
All unresolved-history rows retained outside selected/decisive history totals; phase, missing evidence, votes/shares and sources unchanged.

Градец 2015: six first-round rows and two unresolved runoff rows; published runoff field differs from first-round top two. No completed 2015 history supplied. Missing withdrawal/correction/intervening decision stays open.
